implementation_decisions.decision: Introduce GiftOpeningSourceCatalog generated from effective src_64 and exact effective (item_id,gift_id) keys; preserve raw ordered drop occurrences/candidates for future Phase3 but assign no probability semantics.
GiftOpeningPlanner is stateless and entropy-free in Phase2; only capability ORDINARY_CURRENT_OWNERS is executable.
GiftOpeningService reuses StackInventory, RewardTransactionService and PlayerUnitOfWork; one request transaction debits source stack and settles rewards atomically.

For source routes supporting num, deterministic compatibility batching repeats/scales the selected gift operation num times and aggregates ordinary stack/scalar rewards. Exact official loop remains UNKNOWN.
MID241 awards are explicitly projected as table_id/item_num reward rows; scalar/progression rewards remain cumulative economy_ through existing typed journal projection.
